en: There is water under this floor. I can hear it moving.
Whatever is down there has been growing a long while with nobody watching it.
Ask what it smells
Wet rope. Old bread. And something that used to be a person.
Tell it to stay close
I am always close. That is the arrangement.
Say nothing
Mm. Suit yourself.
The stair goes down. The stair is the only thing here that goes down.
Go down
Of course we do.
Stand here a moment longer
A moment. Then down.
Nothing tried to eat us today. That is a day.
Sleep. I will wake you if the water changes.
Sit down. No - all the way down.
You bled on my map. That is the second time this month.
It will keep. Most things keep.
It is dead. I watched it stop.
I have never smelled anything go quiet like that.
Not a mark on you. Do not get used to it.
You went down.
I am not going to say anything else about it tonight.
Step light. There is nothing under this floor but water and whatever is swimming in it.
Look at the shape of it. Somebody stood like that, once.
The walls are moving. Slowly, but they are moving.
They are not breathing. They are watching. That is you they are leaning towards.
Fill your chest at the door and do not let it go until the far side. It only wants the air you give it.
The stair sounds hollow underfoot. Whatever is below it is not stone.
There is a shape in it you recognise, and you would rather not.
The walls of the gallery rise and fall, slowly, all together.
They lean when you lean. It is not the air moving them.
It wants the air you give it. Take one breath at the door and do not give it another.
